configurations.name: api-4100
runtimeArgs: cd apps/api && [ -f .env.local ] && { set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; }; [ -n "${API_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ] || eval "$(node -e 'const k=require(`web-push`).generateVAPIDKeys(); console.log(`export API_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=${k.publicKey} API_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=${k.privateKey} API_VAPID_SUBJECT=mailto:dev@kavor.vn`)')"; SRK=$(supabase status -o env | grep '^SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=' | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:55321 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="$SRK" SMTP_URL=smtp://127.0.0.1:55325 API_PORT=4100 exec pnpm exec tsx src/main.ts

configurations.name: pwa
runtimeArgs: cd experiments/kavor-pwa && [ -f dist/index.html ] || npm run -s build:api; PORT=8091 API_TARGET=${API_TARGET:-http://127.0.0.1:4000} exec node tools/serve.mjs
